method: Static audit: grep singletons / instance / bind / static properties / Auth manipulation
Provider audit: AppServiceProvider, AuthServiceProvider, BroadcastServiceProvider, EventServiceProvider, RouteServiceProvider, bootstrap/app.php
Service audit: BranchScope, DefaultAccessModelTrait, PricingService, FiscalSequenceService, AuditLogService, RedisIdempotencyKeyRepository, SyncMetricsRecorder
Config audit: session.php, sanctum.php, auth.php, idempotency.php
Cross-reference: H.1 Multi-user RBAC concurrent test (already executed Phase H) for empirical validation

environment.fpm_model: process-per-request (one PHP-FPM worker handles one request at a time; concurrent requests are served by distinct workers)

scenarios_audited.scenario: Auth context leak across requests on same FPM worker
scenarios_audited.method: grep Auth::resolveUsing / Auth::setUser / Auth::login in app/ - zero hits outside Sanctum's own resolution chain. Laravel resolves Auth per-request via Sanctum guard. Sanctum re-resolves $user from token DB lookup on EVERY request — no static $resolvedUser cache survives between requests in the same worker.
scenarios_audited.empirical_verification: Phase H.1.1 + H.1.2 (4 cashiers x distinct branches concurrent /api/admin/pos-order) — every cashier's order rows attributed correctly to (auth-user-id, branch_id). Zero cross-user attribution observed.

scenarios_audited.scenario: Branch context leak via BranchScope / DefaultAccessModelTrait
scenarios_audited.method: Read BranchScope::apply + DefaultAccessModelTrait::branch — they call Auth::check() + Auth::id() EVERY query, no internal caching. CLAUDE.md §8 boot guard rejects CACHE_DRIVER=array in production, so Cache::lock() (audit chain) is cross-worker coherent on redis. BranchScope is registered on 20 models per BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest baseline.
scenarios_audited.empirical_verification: Phase H.1.4 — cashA (branch=1) and cashC (branch=2) hit /api/admin/order concurrently; per-request branch_id filter held. admin (branch=0) saw cross-branch as expected. BranchScope under_concurrency_OK noted in H1 summary.

scenarios_audited.scenario: Singleton services with mutable internal state
scenarios_audited.method: grep singleton( in app/ and bootstrap/. Found ONLY 4 singletons: (a) bootstrap/app.php — Kernel/ExceptionHandler (Laravel framework — stateless dispatcher), (b) AppServiceProvider:45 — SyncMetricsRecorder.

singletons_audited.note: Laravel framework class. Holds middleware stack as static config array; no per-request mutable state.

Has only ALLOWED_CLIENT_METRICS const + insertMetric writes to DB::table('sync_metrics'). No instance properties. resolveCorrelationId() reads from request() per call — picks up the CURRENT request's header, not a cached value. Safe under concurrent reuse.

scenarios_audited.method: localization middleware calls App::setLocale($locale) on every request before dispatching. PHP-FPM worker handles requests SEQUENTIALLY (not concurrently within the same worker), so request N+1 calls setLocale BEFORE its first translator call. The shared Translator singleton's locale is overwritten per request. Inside ONE request, locale state is consistent. Inter-request, the next setLocale wins.
scenarios_audited.inter_request_carryover_risk: Theoretical: if a downstream service uses __() AFTER a controller manually sets a different locale and then forgets to reset, the next request on the same worker would inherit the wrong locale UNTIL its own localization middleware runs. localization middleware runs FIRST in the route group middleware chain (before any controller logic), so this window is empty.
scenarios_audited.v1_practical_risk: LOW. V1 is French-only — even a leak between fr/en is cosmetic, not security.

scenarios_audited.method: vendor/spatie/laravel-permission/src/Traits/HasPermissions.php — permissions are cached per-user via Spatie's internal getCacheKey() (keyed by user_id + guard). No global cross-user cache.
scenarios_audited.empirical_verification: Phase H.1.5 — assigned permission to role, probe cashA OK; revoked permission via Spatie::forgetCachedPermissions; cashA fresh-load saw revocation IMMEDIATELY. Cache invalidation per-user works.

scenarios_audited.method: Server-side broadcast is stateless. Subscription auth gated per-user via routes/channels.php — Broadcast::channel('branch.{branchId}', ...) re-evaluates per subscribe attempt. Token-name check (NOT tokenCan) is immune to Sanctum '*' wildcard (see GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 S-R3-P0-G heal comment).

scenarios_audited.scenario: Tinker / artisan command state leak between invocations
scenarios_audited.method: Production deployment runs `php artisan` as new process each invocation — no container reuse, no leak surface. Tinker is interactive dev-only, not a production attack surface.

SESSION_DRIVER=file in .env. Each session ID writes to a separate file in storage/framework/sessions/. The 'web' middleware group includes StartSession (Kernel.php:42) — used for legacy admin login flow. API uses Sanctum (stateless bearer tokens), no session involved.
scenarios_audited.config_observed: SESSION_DRIVER=file (local). Production single-box uses file — V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne (CLAUDE.md §8 cloud-prep UNI-03 V1.0.2 backlog tracks widening for ALB multi-instance).

leak_risks_identified.title: Locale state inter-request residue within same FPM worker
leak_risks_identified.description: App::setLocale() mutates the Translator singleton. Between requests on the same worker, the previous locale persists until the next localization middleware runs. localization middleware runs FIRST in route groups so the leak window is empty for any route that includes it. Routes WITHOUT the localization middleware (e.g., bare `web` group routes, /api routes that don't apply it) would inherit the previous request's locale.
leak_risks_identified.mitigation: Current discipline is robust — localization middleware is applied on all admin/profile/frontend route prefixes. V1 is FR-only so even worst-case is cosmetic.
leak_risks_identified.v1_0_2_backlog: OPTIONAL: add localization middleware to web group default, OR explicitly reset Translator locale to default at end of request via a terminate() hook.

leak_risks_identified.title: IdempotencyKeyRepository binding is per-request (not singleton)
leak_risks_identified.severity: P3 INFO — by design, not a leak
leak_risks_identified.description: AppServiceProvider:49 binds RedisIdempotencyKeyRepository via $this->app->bind() — fresh instance per resolution. Cache state lives in Redis (cross-worker shared). Safe.

leak_risks_identified.title: H.1.7 cross-user idempotency leak (CORRELATED, not session-state)
leak_risks_identified.severity: P0 RED — already flagged by H.1 agent
leak_risks_identified.description: Per Phase H.1.7 finding: middleware-layer idempotency scope is CORRECT (branch_id + user_id + hash), BUT the app-layer DB fallback in OrderService::findExistingOrderForIdempotencyRecovery($key, $branchId) lacks user_id filter, AND DB UNIQUE index orders(branch_id, idempotency_key) mirrors that gap. NOT a session-state-leak per se — it's a SCHEMA-level scoping bug. Surfaces under collision (same key across cashiers) only.
leak_risks_identified.v1_blocker: Per H.1 verdict — already in active healing scope (Phase H finding). Not introduced by Phase I.5 audit.

production_defenses_verified.fpm_process_per_request: Implied — Laravel ships with FPM SAPI; one worker = one request at a time. Concurrent requests are served by distinct workers (separate process memory).
production_defenses_verified.boot_guards_against_array_driver: AppServiceProvider:215-222 — CACHE_DRIVER in ['array', 'null'] refuses to boot in production (NF525 audit chain Cache::lock cross-worker coherence). Verified in CLAUDE.md §8.
production_defenses_verified.sanctum_token_expiration: config/sanctum.php:51 — 480 minutes default; per-request EnsureUserStatusActive middleware revokes tokens whose user.status flipped to inactive (Sprint H1 Z6-06).
production_defenses_verified.per_request_user_status_revalidation: EnsureUserStatusActive middleware (app/Http/Middleware/EnsureUserStatusActive.php) re-reads users.status from DB on every authenticated request — closes the 480-min token TTL hole for status revocation.
production_defenses_verified.branch_scope_global: BranchScope::apply re-resolves Auth::id() per query — no internal cache. DefaultAccessModelTrait::branch() same pattern.
production_defenses_verified.broadcast_channel_authz_per_subscribe: routes/channels.php — Broadcast::channel re-evaluates per subscription attempt. Token-name check (NOT tokenCan) is wildcard-immune.
production_defenses_verified.idempotency_scoping_at_middleware: IdempotencyKeyMiddleware:77-80 — scopedKey = sprintf('idempotency:v1:%d:%d:%s', branchId, userId, payloadHash). Per-(branch, user, payload) isolation enforced at HTTP layer.
production_defenses_verified.no_static_mutable_properties_in_app_serv: grep static \$ in app/ — zero static instance properties found in business services. Only `static fn` (PHP 8 stateless lambdas) and `static function`.
production_defenses_verified.stateless_singleton_SyncMetricsRecorder: Only mutable singleton candidate — has no instance properties, only const + DB writes. Reuse-safe.
production_defenses_verified.spatie_permission_cache_per_user: Spatie's HasPermissions cache keyed per-user. Phase H.1.5 verified invalidation works immediately on revoke.

empirical_cross_validation.phase_h_h1_1_concurrent_login: PASS — 4 distinct user tokens minted, identity_match TRUE for all
empirical_cross_validation.phase_h_h1_2_concurrent_action_attributi: PASS — 4 distinct orders, each attributed to correct cashier/branch
empirical_cross_validation.phase_h_h1_6_session_token_leak: PASS — stale token correctly 401, cashB token untouched after cashA logout

top_3_session_leak_risks: RISK-1 (P3 INFO): Translator locale state inter-request residue if a route is missing localization middleware. Mitigation: middleware already applied on all key routes; V1 FR-only renders worst-case cosmetic.
RISK-2 (P3 INFO — by design): IdempotencyKeyRepository is bind() not singleton(). Fresh per request. Cache state lives in Redis (shared). Not a leak.

RISK-3 (P0 cross-reference): H.1.7 found cross-user idempotency leak at DB/app fallback layer (NOT session-state) — orders(branch_id, idempotency_key) UNIQUE lacks user_id. Belongs to Phase H heal scope, not Phase I.5.
production_defenses_active: FPM process-per-request model precludes intra-worker concurrent leaks
Sanctum bearer + 480min TTL + EnsureUserStatusActive per-request revalidation
BranchScope re-resolves Auth::id() per query — zero static caching
All critical services use PHP 8 private readonly promoted constructors — immutable
Spatie permission cache per-user, invalidates on role/permission mutation
Channel broadcast authz re-evaluated per subscribe with token-name discriminator (wildcard-immune)
summary.decision: GREEN — V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne has NO session-state leak risk between concurrent requests. Static + empirical (Phase H.1) cross-validation converges on the same verdict.
